Every F-P/B-M/B-D/B-P mean weakens or turns negative in2020-2025; CFO_B-GP_B also reverses across periods. complete_P_down_risk_increment.meaning: Months are selected by the contemporaneous realized P outcome only for retrospective risk description. This is not a rule capable of knowing in advance which months will fall. All methods use the same dated down months within a pool/scenario.
complete_P_down_risk_increment.risk_judgment: GP B-M shows a coherent but unconfirmed downside-month benefit: primary+0.3374pp and common+0.3454pp, positive in both fixed periods and all leave-one-year summaries. B-D stays positive too, so the observed difference is not fully reproduced by the specified simple dilution. CFO has better full-path/worst-month descriptions, but its later-period downside-month B-M is-0.0509pp and B-D-0.0369pp. That prevents a general stable cash-generation protection claim.
complete_P_down_risk_increment.counterexamples: GP primary B has a slightly worse full-period worst month than M (-21.0773% vs-20.9385%) and worse2015-2019 worst10% month average by0.0686pp. Common GP shows the same early tail counterexample. CFO later-period worst10% mean is0.0246pp worse than P. Different tail-month sets and one historical drawdown cannot identify a universal risk winner.
complete_P_down_risk_increment.missing_for_risk_answer: uncertainty.json quantifies ordinary monthly means only; it does not quantify the existing conditional down-month difference. Mean-return intervals cannot substitute for that risk quantity.

Their name count/max single-name weights equal M by construction, not extra diversification. High return co-movement does not rule out a small risk benefit, but low rank correlation cannot establish independent value.

unknown_and_halt.interpretation: Both specified unknown-outcome scenarios leave return conclusions unchanged; this does not settle actual delisting recovery. Nonzero halt weight and quotation conventions preclude fill/account claims.

financial_meaning_and_competing_explanat: GP/assets represents gross earning capacity relative to end-year assets; CFO/assets measures operating cash generation and working-capital/tax timing, not full quality or authenticated profit.
A blend can temper extreme momentum exposures without creating a separate causal signal. D partly tests this simple dilution but does not match every nonlinear concentration/volatility effect.
Fixed industry weights reduce industry allocation differences; within-industry capital intensity, size, valuation and past volatility/liquidity exposures remain alternatives.
Shared market movement dominates return co-movement. Low score overlap plus modest risk descriptions are not financial-information independence.

Source-selected coverage can differ for difficult firms: later-exit common coverage31.80% versus44.48% otherwise; approximately88% of eligible stock-months use disclosed v2 recovery with older notices unresolved. Same-pool arithmetic does not remove this selection.

The price history was previously viewed; new financial definitions and this review do not turn it into genuinely unseen confirmation. Annual financial values and stocks repeat across132 common market months.
